# SBFB sharding — agent index

> Distributed LLM inference across machines: a model too large for one node is
> split layer-wise into a signed pipeline over a private compute group, on the
> custom ALPN `sbfb/shard/1`. This index points an agent at the rank-1 sources
> it must read to wire or review sharding **without hallucinating**.
>
> **Status: PROVISIONAL.** The signed primitives, data plane, and read-only
> control plane are live; the in-vivo session orchestrator (pilots generation,
> emits signed proofs, populates a live session store) is a carry **S78**.
>
> **Truth Stack** (trust the higher rank on conflict):
> `repo files > .planning/active/ > commits > prompts > chat`. A fact absent from
> rank-1 (a repo file) is **`Not evidenced`** — do not assert it. `.planning/`
> is an in-flight pointer, not a durable anchor.

## Start here (agent contract)

- [WIRING_SPEC.md](./WIRING_SPEC.md): contract-dense, source-anchored wiring spec — actor model, per-step contract, INVIOLABLE invariants. Read this first.
- [SHARD_PROTOCOL_SPEC.md](../protocol/SHARD_PROTOCOL_SPEC.md): the machine wire spec — domain tags, generated JSON Schemas, types, caps.

## Wire primitives (rank-1 source)

- [shard_plan.rs](../../crates/nexus-core-rs/src/shard_plan.rs): signed manifest + run proof; sign/verify is `crates/nexus-core-rs/src/shard_plan.rs:verify_signature`, contiguity is `crates/nexus-core-rs/src/shard_plan.rs:is_pipeline_contiguous`.
- [placement.rs](../../crates/nexus-coordinator-rs/src/placement.rs): full-model coverage is the SEPARATE check `crates/nexus-coordinator-rs/src/placement.rs:covers_full_model` (contiguity ≠ coverage).
- [canonical.rs](../../crates/nexus-core-rs/src/canonical.rs): domain-separation tags, e.g. `crates/nexus-core-rs/src/canonical.rs:DOMAIN_SHARD_PLAN_V1` and `crates/nexus-core-rs/src/canonical.rs:DOMAIN_RUN_PROOF_V1`.
- [compute_group.rs](../../crates/nexus-core-rs/src/compute_group.rs): private admission allowlist; membership is `crates/nexus-core-rs/src/compute_group.rs:is_member`.
- [shard.rs](../../crates/nexus-core-rs/src/shard.rs): data plane `sbfb/shard/1`; non-member rejected by `crates/nexus-core-rs/src/shard.rs:SHARD_REJECT_NOT_MEMBER` before any frame read.
- [shard_claim.rs](../../crates/nexus-worker-core/src/engine/shard_claim.rs): worker admission `crates/nexus-worker-core/src/engine/shard_claim.rs:authorize_claim` (crypto before IO).

## Control plane + front

- [http.rs](../../crates/nexus-shell-daemon/src/http.rs): read-only route, body built by `crates/nexus-shell-daemon/src/http.rs:shard_session_response`, privacy projection `crates/nexus-shell-daemon/src/http.rs:project_shard_session`.
- [daemon.ts](../../web/src/api/daemon.ts): front wrapper `web/src/api/daemon.ts:getShardSession`.
- [protocol.ts](../../web/src/bridge/protocol.ts): the bridge whitelist `web/src/bridge/protocol.ts:BridgeMethodSchema` — a closed enum of app-facing methods, none a shard method.

## Runnable examples (compiled / exact)

- [sign_verify.rs](./examples/sign_verify.rs): sign + verify both envelopes; compiled+run by [shard_sign_verify.rs](../../crates/nexus-core-rs/tests/shard_sign_verify.rs).
- [observe.curl.md](./examples/observe.curl.md): `GET /api/daemon/shard-session/{id}` + loopback headers + empty-store response.
- [bridge_gap.md](./examples/bridge_gap.md): why there is NO shard bridge method (PROPOSED / GAP-not-shipped).
